final: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT o.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `order` o JOIN disp p ON p.account_id = o.account_id AND p.type = 'OWNER' JOIN client c ON c.client_id = p.client_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), differences AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS overall_diff FROM account_orders), scored AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, overall_diff, overall_diff - AVG(overall_diff) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS excess FROM differences) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, overall_diff, excess FROM scored WHERE excess > 0 ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
